notes: P18 analyzes the negative-trion Rxy formula in Methods and shows that its sign reversal persists even as f -> 0 (pure exciton drag plus free electrons), directly matching C12, C13, and C18 while partly addressing C25 (novelty beyond earlier drag/trion work) and C26 (whether the Hall signal uniquely arises from trions versus other bound complexes). P3 clarifies that the Hall regions are exciton-trion mixtures, which is related to the meaning of (X+X+)/(X+X-), but C24 is marked not raised because the review does not ask to define those symbols at first appearance.
